title: Isekai with a Cheat of your choosing
description: You get to pick your very own cheat power.
prompt:
You find yourself awake in a random forest with no memory of coming here.
Then, suddenly, a game window pops up.
[Select your Cheat Skill]
It seems you can pick **anything** you would like.
memory: You can have any power you would like, whether from fiction or something you made up.
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.
